title: Smart Traffic Monitoring System
description: AI-powered real-time traffic analysis with vehicle detection, speed estimation, and congestion visualization
longDescription: Developed an AI-powered Smart Traffic Monitoring System capable of detecting and tracking multiple vehicle types with over 95% accuracy, along with lane detection and lane-change alerts. Built AI-driven traffic analytics including live speed estimation, traffic-density classification (Low/Moderate/High/Severe), type-wise vehicle counting, and congestion-zone visualization with GPS-based routing and satellite map overlays through Google Maps APIs. Designed a responsive web dashboard with real-time charts, analytics panels, CSV/PDF export for traffic reports, and voice-enabled features such as dashboard voice control and automatic weather announcements.

title: AI Cyber Shield
description: NLP-powered system to detect fake offers and phishing attempts — Cyberverse Hackathon Runner-Up
longDescription: An intelligent cybersecurity tool that uses Natural Language Processing to analyze and detect fraudulent offers, phishing emails, and scam messages. Built with FastAPI backend and sophisticated ML models for high accuracy threat detection. This project won Runner-Up at the Cyberverse Hackathon at VIT Vellore.

title: Ransomware Simulator & Defence Mechanism
description: Educational simulator demonstrating ransomware-style file encryption, detection, and recovery workflows
longDescription: Developed a ransomware simulation tool that detects corrupted files and demonstrates file encryption and decryption workflows for security testing and analysis. Implemented automated corrupted-file detection with configurable auto-deletion of infected files to simulate basic incident response and recovery behavior. Built for academic learning, it allows users to upload files, simulate encryption, view a generated key, and securely restore data.

title: Smart Pantry Management System
description: IoT-based kitchen inventory tracking with RFID, ultrasonic sensors, and dish recommendation engine
longDescription: Developed an IoT-based Smart Pantry system using RFID, ultrasonic, and vibration sensors for real-time food inventory tracking and accurate detection of item placement or removal. Built an OLED-based live inventory display and inventory-driven dish recommendation feature on a web dashboard using available ingredients.

title: Blood Donation Website
description: Web platform connecting blood donors and recipients with real-time matching based on blood group and location
longDescription: Developed a web platform to connect blood donors and recipients, enabling quick search and real-time matching based on blood group, location, and availability. Implemented secure user authentication with registration and login features to manage donor and recipient profiles.
